name: chevron-down
description: Represents expandable content or more below. On hover the chevron dips downward, gesturing at what lies beneath.

animation.description: Chevron translates +2.5px on y and returns (0.3s easeOut) — a downward dip toward the hidden content. One-shot, ends at rest. Reduced motion: static.

accessibility.notes: Pair with aria-expanded on the controlling button when used as a disclosure control.
